description:
An Orchestral piece mixed with rock and metal elements. Also, some muskets. Because why not.

Inspired by various Two Steps From Hell tracks.

Fusils are musket-like flintlock rifles typically given to artillery and officer units, as well as elite soldiers. They were lighter than the typical musket, and were as much a sign of leadership and class as they were weapons, in many countries. 

Flare, in this case, refers to the Congreve Rocket. Long range artillery used in the revolutionary era, they are best well known for their red glow, similar to the glow of a flare. These are also the inspiration for the line "And the rockets red glare" In the Star-Spangled Banner.

This name was chosen to represent the two sections of this track - an orchestral section and a orchestra + guitar section.
